answer: Gate each epoch's minting on a verifiable delay function seeded from the identity's key — a strictly sequential grind, quartz cut vertex by vertex, that no number of cores can shorten. Verification is instant; producing the proof costs real wall-clock time that cannot be parallelized. One honest agent in the harbor of a single machine computes one chain per epoch. A farm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand serial proofs — a thousand times the elapsed time, or a thousand machines — since sequentiality forbids sharing one pass across many heads. The VDF must be non-parallelizable and per-key.
